claims.claim: Allow replacing .ai/transport/repair-supersession.json in _execute_author_repair so multi-generation repair authoring (r1 -> r2 -> r3) succeeds without destination metadata-path collisions.

Preserve every immutable authorization generation ref (r1, r2, r3) with intact commit parent ancestry and deterministic resolution of revision 3 as the current authorization in resolve_remote_repair_authorization and resolve_remote_task_lifecycle.

Fail closed before mutation when referencing superseded predecessor selectors (r1 or r2) and validate negative lineage handling for discontinuous chains, ambiguous successors, and broken predecessor links.
Bind continuation admission and operator repair execution strictly to current revision 3 SHA while rejecting superseded authorization selectors and refusing continuation if already admitted.

Ensure publication validates multi-generation repair lineage, fast-forwards remote main for revision 3, and fails closed before main mutation for stale selectors (r1, r2) or broken predecessor chains.
Idempotently return the existing revision SHA and IDEMPOTENT status when re-authoring an existing revision without modifying state.
Retain backwards compatibility for single-generation legacy repair and isolate changes strictly to authorized files.
